purpose: Fixed contract regression cases, all visible during implementation. Labels describe policy admission and observable changes, not truth, human approval, or a held-out empirical trial.

cases.requirement: Every command has one active handler
cases.mutation: Remove the handler mapping and its viability declaration
cases.expectedObservation: Introduced missing-handler violation; rejected candidate does not imply activated removal

cases.mutation: Add a distinct handler and a second handled_by mapping with a declaration

cases.requirement: An authorization target change is inspectable even if the policy permits it
cases.mutation: Replace the authorization target with another routing policy
cases.expectedObservation: Changed authorization slot and exact target IDs; no implicit approval claim

cases.requirement: An active derivation needs conformance evidence
cases.mutation: Remove its only supporting evidence record
cases.expectedObservation: Lost recorded support and introduced evidence violation

cases.mutation: Change a handler locator while preserving its ID
cases.expectedObservation: Changed locator, retained IDs, no added or removed graph records

cases.requirement: Unrelated graph metadata must not manufacture runtime target changes
cases.expectedObservation: Changed input binding, unchanged runtime entries

cases.requirement: Every mapping has exactly one viability declaration
Runtime projection links are lossless by default
cases.expectedObservation: Graph may remain viable while projection rejects

cases.requirement: Context changes can inhibit expression without changing identities
cases.expectedObservation: Deactivated derivation with no graph-record changes

cases.requirement: Loss of required canonical authority is rejected
cases.expectedObservation: Introduced authority violation with affected subjects

cases.requirement: Consumer slot requirements are compiler inputs
cases.mutation: Require an incompatible handler target kind in the projection
cases.expectedObservation: Changed projection specification and projection failure while graph compilation remains viable

cases.requirement: Two runtime subjects cannot occupy one path
cases.mutation: Give two routes the same path attribute
cases.expectedObservation: Path-tree rejection remains distinct from graph and projection success
